Q: How does account authentication work for GitHub Copilot and other AI providers in IntelliJ AI Assistant? A:

JetBrains now uses ACP to consolidate all the AI providers into a single chat window.

To Link your accounts:

The login still happens in the specific plugin settings, when then registers that account as an option in the main chat.

GitHub Copilot: go to settings --> languages & frameworks --> github copilot. Sign in there. Once authenticated GitHub Copilot will appear in the agent dropdown at the top of the AI Assistant chat.

If you added github as a tool (MCP) you only gave the existing ai the access to your data. To use copilot's actual ai you must select it as the agent from that dropdown menu.

if it still does not work then you can refer to this youtube video
https://youtu.be/ap_aTqpL3Ik?si=0l12AbundqDdBrrr

Q: Shelve sqlite3.OperationalError: disk I/O error A:

The problem is SELinux. From SELinux Troubleshooter /usr/bin/sealert:

SELinux is preventing python from map access on the file /tmp/my_site_-shm.

*****  Plugin catchall_boolean (47.5 confidence) suggests   ******************

If you want to allow httpd to unified
Then you must tell SELinux about this by enabling the 'httpd_unified' boolean.

Do
setsebool -P httpd_unified 1

*****  Plugin catchall_boolean (47.5 confidence) suggests   ******************

If you want to allow domain to can mmap files
Then you must tell SELinux about this by enabling the 'domain_can_mmap_files' boolean.

Do
setsebool -P domain_can_mmap_files 1

*****  Plugin catchall (6.38 confidence) suggests   **************************

If you believe that python should be allowed map access on the my_site_-shm file by default.
Then you should report this as a bug.
You can generate a local policy module to allow this access.
Do
allow this access for now by executing:
# ausearch -c 'python' --raw | audit2allow -M my-python
# semodule -X 300 -i my-python.pp

To fix it:

# setsebool -P httpd_unified on

# semanage boolean -l | grep httpd_unified
httpd_unified                  (on   ,   on)  Allow httpd to unified

# setsebool -P domain_can_mmap_files 1

# ausearch -c 'python' --raw | audit2allow -M my-python
******************** IMPORTANT ***********************
To make this policy package active, execute:

semodule -i my-python.pp

root@d3:~# semodule -X 300 -i my-python.pp

I don't know if the first three commands are enough or if the last two are enough. If someone understands it please comment.
